scenarios.scenario-1: Default runtime system prompt self-identifies as MAGRA.
scenarios.scenario-2: CLI and dashboard primary labels show MAGRA.
scenarios.scenario-3: `reasonix` and `dsnix` compatibility aliases still route to the same CLI entry point.

evidence-types.evidence-1: Deterministic assertions inspect prompt text, package bins, CLI help output, and dashboard labels.
evidence-types.evidence-2: Trace assertions verify compatibility alias paths are explicitly marked as aliases.
evidence-types.evidence-3: Integration checks launch CLI entry points without changing public command behavior.

verification-levels.level-1: Run runtime identity tests for prompt and metadata surfaces.
verification-levels.level-2: Run Reasonix base compatibility tests and dashboard smoke tests.
verification-levels.level-3: Run lint, typecheck, MyGRACE lint, and build before marking Phase-9 done.

telemetry-requirements.telemetry-1: Health and doctor output identify the product as MAGRA.
telemetry-requirements.telemetry-2: Compatibility alias usage is visible as alias metadata, not a primary product rename.

autonomous-safety.safety-1: Autonomous edits may update branding strings only when tests preserve CLI compatibility aliases.
autonomous-safety.safety-2: Any user-facing primary Reasonix identity in runtime surfaces blocks Phase-9 completion.
